title: Integrated metabolomics and transcriptomics analysis during seed germination of waxy corn under low temperature stress
genotypes: N28 (waxy corn inbred; low-temperature tolerant); N67 (waxy corn inbred; low-temperature sensitive)
tissue: germinating seeds (whole; 5 seeds pooled per sample); non-germinated dry seeds as reference
stage_age: germination; sampled 3 d after start of germination (when the N67 radicle broke through the seed coat at 15 °C)
growth_system: growth chamber (artificial climate box); sterile petri dishes with wet filter paper; 16 h light/8 h dark
control_temperature: 25 °C (NT) germination for 3 d; non-germinated dry seeds (MC) are the reference for the reported DEGs
other_factors: tolerant vs sensitive inbreds; dry seed vs germinated
timepoints_duration: RNA-seq and metabolomics at 3 d; physiological indices at 0, 24, 48, 72, 96 h at 15 °C
n_libraries: 18 (stated: 18 samples; = 2 lines x 3 conditions [dry seed, 25 °C, 15 °C] x 3 reps, computed)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq (model and read layout NR); 148.09 Gb clean data; HISAT2 to B73 reference
other_omics: widely targeted metabolomics (UPLC-MS/MS); physiology (EC, MDA, SOD, CAT, POD, proline, soluble sugar)
key_finding: Tolerant N28 vs sensitive N67 under 15 °C germination: hormone and MAPK genes up and flavonoids enriched in N28.
notes: Reported contrasts are LT vs dry seed (MC vs ML) and N67 vs N28 under LT; NT-germinated samples were also sequenced but no LT vs NT contrast is reported in the text. growth_system: artificial climate chamber (Panasonic MLR-352H-PC), Chengdu; pots with peat/pine needle/yellow clay substrate; 75% humidity; illumination written as 3000 µmol m-2 s-1; photoperiod NR

other_factors: tolerant introgression line vs B73; F2:3 population (MIL-IB030 x MIL-IB021) phenotyped at 2 °C for QTL mapping (no RNA-seq)
timepoints_duration: 3 d and 5 d at 2 °C, plus 24 h recovery (sequence of recovery step not explicit); each with 25 °C control
n_libraries: 36 (stated: 36 samples; = 2 genotypes x 2 temperatures x 3 time points x 3 reps, computed)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 4000 (read layout NR); TopHat2 to B73 v4
other_omics: QTL mapping (SSR map, 289 F2:3 families); phenotyping; qPCR
key_finding: Cold RNA-seq plus WGCNA and QTL mapping nominate two candidate genes for cold tolerance in introgression line MIL-IB030.

tissue: whole seedlings (root + shoot) for Cold-15 and CK-3; dry seed embryos for CK-0
stage_age: germinating seedlings (paper rolls); Cold-15 and CK-3 at similar developmental stage

control_temperature: 25 °C for 3 d (CK-3); dry seed embryo non-germination control (CK-0)
other_factors: tolerant donor vs sensitive recurrent parent vs near-isogenic lines (QTL qp1ER1-1)
timepoints_duration: Cold-15 (10 °C, 15 d), CK-3 (25 °C, 3 d), CK-0 (dry embryo)
n_libraries: 24 (stated: 24 RNA samples = 4 genotypes x 3 conditions x 2 reps)
